body:
Please describe the documentation change in an issue first; pull requests are limited to collaborators. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md) for the contribution process. The earlier discussion about enabling pull requests from forks is #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
